subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 11: Get ready for… A2 Flyers and A2 Key
outcomes: Listen and match people to places.
Choose the best answer in a conversation.
Use exam tips to check your answers.

tf.s: In a listening test, a speaker may mention more than one place.
tf.why: Yes, so listen carefully to the end.

tf.s: You should choose the first place you hear, without listening more.
tf.why: Listen until the end to find the place the person really went to.

tf.s: You should read all the answers before you choose one.
tf.why: Yes, that is a good exam tip.

tf.s: “Of course you can!” is a good answer to “Can I come with you?”
tf.why: Yes, it answers the question politely.

tf.s: “In the morning.” is a good answer to “Can I come with you?”
tf.why: In the morning answers a When question.

tf.s: “You have to visit the website” answers “How do we buy tickets?”
tf.why: Yes, it tells us how to buy them.

tf.s: “No, we're taking a picnic” answers “Are you going to have lunch in the café?”
tf.why: Yes, it answers a yes/no question about lunch.

tf.s: Jasim's been a footballer for he was ten.
tf.why: He was ten is a point in time: since he was ten.

tf.s: It is a good idea to check your answers after you finish.
A question with When needs an answer about a place.
tf.why: When asks about time; Where asks about place.

boxes.q: Fahad: Can I come with you?
Fahad: How do we buy tickets?
o: You have to visit the website.

boxes.q: Fahad: Are you going to have lunch in the café?
o: You have to visit the website.
boxes.why: It is a yes/no question about lunch.

boxes.q: Jasim's been a footballer ___ he was ten.
boxes.why: He was ten is a point in time.

boxes.q: A speaker says two places. What should you do?
boxes.why: The correct place may come later.

boxes.q: What should you do before choosing a response?
Which answer fits a When question?
Which answer fits a How question about travel?
boxes.why: How do you go? – By bus.

boxes.q: Which answer fits a Where question?
Which answer fits a Why question?

mcq.q: What should you do if a speaker mentions two places?
o: Listen until the end to find which place the person went to.
Write the first place you hear.
mcq.why: The correct place may come later.

o: Read all the answers before you choose one.
Choose the first answer you see.
mcq.why: Reading every option helps you choose well.

mcq.q: Complete: Jasim's been a footballer ___ he was ten.
mcq.why: He was ten is a point in time.

mcq.q: Fahad: Can I come with you? Choose Yousuf's best answer.
Fahad: How do we buy tickets? Which answer fits?
o: You have to visit the website.
mcq.why: How asks about the way to do something.

mcq.q: Fahad: Are you going to have lunch in the café? Which answer fits?
o: You have to visit the website.
mcq.why: A yes/no question needs Yes or No.

mcq.q: A speaker says: I wanted to go to the cinema, but it was closed, so I went to the park. Where did he go?
mcq.why: Listen to the end: he went to the park.

mcq.q: Why is “In the morning.” a wrong answer to “Can I come with you?”
o: It answers a When question, not a Can question.
It has no verb at the end.
mcq.why: Match the answer to the question word.

mcq.q: Why should you read all the responses before choosing?
o: Another response might fit the question better.
It is faster to choose the first.
The last response is always right.
mcq.why: Comparing options helps you find the best one.
